summary: Mr. Electric of Salt Lake City (www.mrelectricutah.com) is an Established digital presence - Digital Maturity 64/100, Active with 1 location observed - scoring 43 opportunity with 90 confidence. Main addressable issue is Local search context: No structured data was detected on the homepage. (JSON-LD structured data blocks: 0). Fundamentals are solid: HTTPS true, viewport true, canonical true, 0 broken links of 50 checked, and SEO 90 but Lighthouse performance/bestPractices were not measured due to launcher error. Booking is off-site with no on-page forms detected, creating a prioritized set of implementation fixes.

topOpportunities.title: Add LocalBusiness structured data for local search context
topOpportunities.evidence: Deterministic finding: No structured data was detected on the homepage. and homepageSignals hasSchema: false with JSON-LD structured data blocks: 0
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Without schema, search engines must infer location/service relevance from text alone. Adding valid JSON-LD is a low-risk way to support rich results and improve consistency with the claimed Google Business Profile.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add LocalBusiness + Electrician JSON-LD to homepage and core service pages (NAP matching 925 E 900 S Suite 201, Salt Lake City) to give Google explicit local context. Keep existing title/description and H1Count: 1 structure.

topOpportunities.title: Fix sitemap completeness vs discovered site
topOpportunities.evidence: measuredAudit homepageSignals sitemapPageCount: 2 vs pagesCrawled: 10 and Crawled 10 same-site pages and checked 50 internal links with Internal links observed on homepage: 57
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: A sitemap listing only 2 pages while 10 same-site pages were crawled may limit crawl efficiency for new service pages. Complete sitemap helps discovery without changing design.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Reconcile sitemap.xml to include all indexable service pages discovered (e.g., /electrical-repair, /commercial-service and the 6x Salt Lake City service URLs crawled) and resubmit in Search Console. Ensure canonical true remains.

topOpportunities.title: Add on-site lead capture alongside off-site booking
topOpportunities.evidence: homepageSignals forms: 0, inputCount: 0, hasEmail: false on all 10 crawled pages (each forms: 0) despite hasPhone: true, CTA phrases detected: 4, and businessIntelligence Online booking or request link: detected
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Current conversion relies on phone and off-site booking link. An on-page form provides a measurable alternative path that can be tracked in the existing GA4 stack and may capture users who prefer not to call.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add a native on-site estimate/request form (with hasEmail contact option) alongside the existing booking link and phone CTA. Keep GA4 tracking and test form completion as a conversion in GA4.

topOpportunities.title: Validate real mobile performance - audit was not measured
topOpportunities.evidence: measuredAudit componentStatus lighthouse status: Failed with error: The CHROME_PATH environment variable must be set ... and businessIntelligence Digital Maturity Mobile performance points: 4/20 with evidence Lighthouse 0/100 and Lighthouse bestPractices/performance null
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Performance and bestPractices are unknown due to launcher failure, so optimization can't be prioritized accurately. A clean re-test will confirm if the heavy homepage (wordCount 3086) needs speed work.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Re-run Lighthouse/PageSpeed in a proper Chrome environment to get real Performance and Best Practices scores, then prioritize image/script optimization for the 42 images on homepage if scores are low. MobileQuality is Good per audit but not lab-verified.
